subject: RX 7900 XTX farewell benchmark series
provenance: Measurements and scores supplied in user/agent reports in this conversation; raw host log files and model hashes not yet archived here.

software.note: No native Strata Vulkan LLM backend; Strata CLI external Vulkan integration used llama.cpp Vulkan server.

v1_runs.configuration: Swift 1.5 27B dense / Strata CLI to llama.cpp Vulkan
v1_runs.notes: Extended CLI using external custom endpoint; exact prompts and deterministic settings reportedly matched direct Vulkan baseline.
Approximate values from comparison summary; not provided at full precision.
Used conservative eager/BF16-KV configuration after MTP and INT8-KV settings failed sanity checks; not an optimized vLLM comparison.

v3_runs.notes: 30/30 vs previously validated IQ3_S answer sheet; separately V1 29/30 L04.
C05 correct; C05 required 25,222 generated tokens and ~181 seconds in this run.
Only difference relative to Qwen IQ2_XS answer sheet was M06, corrected B to D.

protocol.v1: All 30 questions from frozen v1; model variants native Strata HIP used temperature 0, 32,768 max generation tokens, same prompts and key; runtime excludes cold model loading.
protocol.v3: All 30 questions from frozen v3; independent requests on XTX, temperature 0, 32,768 token generation limit, raw reasoning counted in decode; 30/30 answer line completion for all three native Strata HIP variants.
notes: Decode speed includes reasoning output and excludes prefill. Wall-clock benchmark time and simple token/s products need not align perfectly due to request and prompt overhead.
Cross-backend results are not always precisely matched in KV format, MTP and execution mode; especially vLLM ROCm, which was conservative.
Scores are reported from submitted answers; original full raw per-question logs remain with experiment runners unless uploaded to this repo.

outstanding: Flint small-MoE performance test on XTX was planned, but no XTX result was reported in this snapshot.
